theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_canonical_tangent_representation
theorems.statement: AllardRectifiabilityTheorem → FirstRectifiabilityTheorem → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight x θ ∧ 0 < θ) → ∃ θ : Euclidean N → ℝ, IsVarifoldOf V {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'} θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'}, (∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane V x T (θ x)) ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) ∧ ∀ Z ⊆ {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'}, V.weight Z = 0 → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) Z = 0
